verdict.rationale: Kick's own documentation site serves a live llms.txt index (confirmed by an HTTP 200 probe) along with .md markdown mirrors of every page and a documented `?ask=` query interface, so a user can point an agent straight at agent-legible docs. These surfaces are generated by GitBook rather than built by Kick, but they are published for Kick's own docs, which is what the story asks for. Missing for 10: Kick-authored agent-specific guidance beyond the auto-generated GitBook surfaces, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.kick.co/llms.txt # Kick Docs
Perform an HTTP GET request on the current page URL with the ask query parameter... The response will contain a direct answer to the question and relevant excerpts and sources from the documentation.
